status: Diagnostic-driven coverage study; methods and settings fixed before the new simulation results
label_rule: Order component means by coordinate 0, then coordinate 1 for an exact tie. Targets are observable ordered-mixture functionals; truth never chooses labels for fitting or intervals.
failure_rule: Retain all attempts and starts. Do not redraw failed bootstrap samples. Report each method's valid count, boundary count, exclusions, availability, conditional coverage, and covered-and-available fraction.
bootstrap_warning: Intervals computed from successful bootstrap fits approximate a conditional numerical distribution when any draws fail. Full-draw availability is reported separately. No coverage improvement is assumed.
